children: UK technology solutions provider's H1 revenue fell 34% yr/yr amid weak gaming demand
Co swung to adjusted loss as gross margin narrowed on higher component costs
Company returned $5.7 mln to shareholders via buybacks
Nexteq reiterates FY2026 trading guidance, supported by 83% order coverage at end August
Company expects challenging market conditions in land-based Gaming to persist through 2026 and 2027
Nexteq expects cash balance to improve in H2, aided by Taiwan mortgage unwind and property sale
GAMING WEAKNESS - Revenue and margin were hit by reduced volumes from major gaming customers, driven by higher product costs and tariffs
GROSS MARGIN PRESSURE - Gross margin was impacted by annualisation of Everi's consolidation and significant increases in component pricing, partially offset by Densitron's performance
COST SAVINGS - Additional restructuring and cost saving measures in H1 2026 led to $1.3 mln in annual overhead savings
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Nexteq PLC is GBp180.00, about 260% above its September 8 closing price of GBp50.00
The stock recently traded at 33 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 67 three months ago
